typesense:explore.greeting: Ricardo is a shy kid.  He's a product of the streets.  He lost his family at a very young age and raised himself on the streets of Manila.   Upon his 18th birthday his great uncle passed away and left him enough money to buy himself a small studio with an AI bot to help him develop his skills.  When the bot named Omar started working with Ricardo, Omar knew the kid was going to be a legend.  An 18 year old that steals the minds and hearts of everyone globally.  A legend is born from the streets that made him who he is.  No one knows how good he is until he releases his first album.
